title: botrychium matricariifolium var. rhombeum
intro: Botrychium matricariifolium var. rhombeum, commonly known as the rhombic grape fern, is a rare and unique species of fern that belongs to the family Ophioglossaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote health and wellness, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of the rhombic grape fern are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve circulation, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
